|lore=Qui-Gon Jinn's Padawan. Stayed behind to protect Queen Amidala when Qui-Gon left to explore Mos Espa, but was in constant communication should he be needed.
|game_text=Deploys -2 (and landspeed = 2) on Tatooine. If a card was just stacked on Credits Will Do Fine, may take a non-character card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While at opponent's Watto's Junkyard, its Light Side game text is canceled. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.

|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V) (ALT) (Virtual Set 0) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-obiwankenobipadawanlearner_ai-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-obiwankenobipadawanl022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/obiwankenobipadawanlearner_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/obiwankenobipadawanlearner_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V)”; slip number “3•24” at bottom right. Text: “Deploys -2 (and landspeed = 2) on Tatooine. If a card was just stacked on Credits Will Do Fine, may take a non-character card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While at opponent's Watto's Junkyard, its Light Side game text is canceled. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V) (ALT) (Virtual Set 0) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-obiwankenobipadawanlab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/obiwankenobipadawanlearner_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/obiwankenobipadawanlearner_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
